metadata.description: Claude Code mods by ezoushen — plugins whose behavior lives in hooks modules.

plugins.name: mermaid-pane
plugins.description: Renders mermaid code blocks inline as ASCII art (beautiful-mermaid, termaid) or images with an open-full-size button; mermaid.ink is opt-in via /mermaid external on.

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: Render image paths inline: a thumbnail in the user's prompt row (aspect-fill, max 10 rows) and in agent reply rows when the model mentions a path. Recognises a file path ending in a supported image extension (quoted or with escaped spaces too), or an [Image #N] token for a pasted picture.

plugins.name: prompt-redact
plugins.description: Replaces secrets and credentials with stable placeholders inside Claude Code before the model or the session file ever sees them — prompts, tool results, replies, attachments and compaction summaries — and restores real values only in Edit/Write/NotebookEdit arguments. 220-rule corpus plus checksum detectors, a benign-shape allowlist, fail-closed scanning and a /redact pane. No network, no subprocess, no model call.
